create_ood_transformers: create OOD transformers for train and eval datasets given a number of classes and OOD fraction
sample_classes: sample a random subset of class labels from a given range using a fixed seed

review_ood_transform: review the OOD dataset transformation logic that filters batches based on out-of-distribution labels
